rationale: POST wallet response now also accepts a JARM 'response' form field (signature-verified); malformed form or invalid JWT now returns 400 instead of an uncaught failure.
Whitespace, log message redaction and switch-to-arrow syntax only; same statuses and bodies.
comment_id in comment page request is now decoded from short ID; short IDs previously unresolved are now accepted.
Entitlements with null purchase or null contracts previously threw NPE in billing id extraction; now null id is returned and entry skipped with a warning.
Visitor handler function types gain a context parameter; internal, no HTTP behaviour change.
PATCH project formerly took a Project body; now requires query parameters name and office and renames via dao.renameProject, ignoring the body.
Import/package changes of bean classes and removal of duplicate local variable declarations; logic unchanged.
Only interface declarations added (countByJobId, JobTargetRepository); no implementation or HTTP path.
Simple group entity now also returns environmentId and environmentName. Files contain unresolved merge-conflict markers.
New GET /wallet/jarm/{requestId}/jwks.json operation; by-reference client metadata jwks URI now points to it instead of public-keys.json.
ACCEPT header definition's writeToExternalHeaders flag changes true to false, so accept is no longer published in outgoing external headers.
Function moved to a new file with variable renames; logic identical.
Listing commits with a non-existent sha returned 500 on GetCommit error; now returns 404 when the error is not-exist.
